name: Lash Out
description:
You lash out to vent your frustration toward the target. Make a melee attack, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit.

If you are suffering from a non-volatile status condition, or any of your AC, STR, DEX, CON, INT, WIS, or CHA is currently lowered, then you make the attack with advantage and deal an additional MOVE {type} damage.
